pages.quiz:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which sound repeats most in "Montags macht mir meine muntere Mutter mittags meistens Mus"? (1 mark)
   A. sch
   B. k
   C. z
   D. m

2. What does "die Gabel" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. chair
   B. fork
   C. table
   D. sofa

3. Which day comes right after Donnerstag? (1 mark)
   A. Sonntag
   B. Dienstag
   C. Freitag
   D. Mittwoch

4. What does "der Hals" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. leg
   B. toe
   C. eye
   D. neck

5. Which word has the sound "ow" as in "cow"? (1 mark)
   A. heute
   B. Tier
   C. nein
   D. Haus

6. How is the letter K named in German? (1 mark)
   A. ess
   B. bay
   C. kah
   D. vay

7. What should your voice do at a full stop? (1 mark)
   A. Go up
   B. Speed up
   C. Whisper
   D. Go down and stop

8. What does "der Tisch" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. cooker
   B. sofa
   C. door
   D. table

9. What does "der Kühlschrank" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. window
   B. bed
   C. living room
   D. fridge

10. What does "Gut gemacht!" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Be quiet!
   B. One more time!
   C. See you soon!
   D. Well done!

11. Which German word means "yesterday"? (time) (1 mark)
   A. jetzt
   B. morgen
   C. gestern
   D. heute

12. Which German word is the number 11? (1 mark)
   A. sieben
   B. elf
   C. zwanzig
   D. sechzehn

13. What does "Seine Freunde kommen" mean? (1 mark)
   A. His friends are singing
   B. His family is leaving
   C. His friends are sleeping
   D. His friends are coming

14. Which German word is the number 19? (1 mark)
   A. elf
   B. zwölf
   C. eins
   D. neunzehn

15. Which food group does "das Wasser" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Gemüse
   B. die Getränke
   C. das Obst
   D. das Fleisch

16. What does "sehen" mean? (1 mark)
   A. to speak
   B. to hear
   C. to see
   D. to eat

17. Which body part do we link with "riechen"? (1 mark)
   A. der Fuß
   B. das Ohr
   C. der Mund
   D. die Nase

18. Which German word or phrase means "son"? (1 mark)
   A. die Mutter
   B. die Schwester
   C. der Sohn
   D. der Bruder

19. Which form completes "Ihr ___ ein Haus"? (1 mark)
   A. hat
   B. habt
   C. hast
   D. habe

20. Which German word or phrase means "sofa"? (1 mark)
   A. der Stuhl
   B. der Topf
   C. der Löffel
   D. das Sofa

21. Which sentence is written correctly? (1 mark)
   A. Der Tisch ist in der Kuche.
   B. Der Tisch ist in dem Küche.
   C. Der Tisch ist in der Küche.
   D. Der Tisch ist im Küche.

22. What is the plural of "das Bett"? (1 mark)
   A. die Better
   B. die Betts
   C. die Betten
   D. die Bette

23. What does "April" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. April
   B. July
   C. September
   D. November

24. Which little word goes with the noun "Kuchen"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. der
   C. den
   D. die

25. Which German word or phrase means "carrot"? (1 mark)
   A. der Kohl
   B. die Mango
   C. die Karotte
   D. das Brot

26. Which little word goes with the noun "Mais"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. das
   C. die
   D. den

27. Which little word goes with the noun "Käse"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. die
   C. der
   D. den

28. Which German word or phrase means "head"? (1 mark)
   A. der Kopf
   B. das Haar
   C. das Gesicht
   D. der Rücken

29. Which German word or phrase means "snow"? (1 mark)
   A. der Wind
   B. der Schnee
   C. die Sonne
   D. der Regen

30. Which completes "Der Ball ist ___ Garten"? (1 mark)
   A. in der
   B. an die
   C. im
   D. auf der

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Read: "Mein Vater heißt Juma. Er ist groß und nett." Write three facts from the text in English. (3 marks)

32. Write three steps you follow to understand a German text. (3 marks)

33. Write the German words with der, die or das for: sugar, child, sofa. (3 marks)

34. Write the German words with der, die or das for: party, foot, head, daughter. (4 marks)

35. Write the German words with der, die or das for: pot, face, father, grandmother. (4 marks)

36. Write a sentence in German that tells in which month your birthday is. (2 marks)

37. Describe the structure of an Elfchen, line by line. (3 marks)

38. Spell the name "Zawadi" using German letter names. (3 marks)

39. Write the German words with der, die or das for: mother, rainbow, hair. (3 marks)

40. Write the German words with der, die or das for: arm, sister. (2 marks)

41. Write the German words with der, die or das for: spoon, supper. (2 marks)

42. Write the German words with der, die or das for: toe, song, juice, egg, water. (5 marks)

43. Write the German words with der, die or das for: daughter, orange. (2 marks)

44. Explain the trick to decide between ie and ei when you write. (2 marks)

45. Write the German words with their articles for: sun, cloud, rain, snow. (4 marks)

46. Write three sentences about today's weather in German. (3 marks)

47. Fill the gaps: "Das Buch ist ___ dem Tisch. Die Katze ist ___ dem Stuhl." Use auf and unter. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #6 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — m
   Nearly every word starts with m.

2. B — fork
   die Gabel means fork.

3. C — Freitag
   After Donnerstag comes Freitag.

4. D — neck
   der Hals means neck.

5. D — Haus
   The letters au sound like ow.

6. C — kah
   In German the letter K is called kah.

7. D — Go down and stop
   A full stop (der Punkt) tells us to end the sentence with a falling voice.

8. D — table
   der Tisch means table.

9. D — fridge
   der Kühlschrank means fridge.

10. D — Well done!
   Gut gemacht is praise.

11. C — gestern
   yesterday in German is gestern.

12. B — elf
   11 in German is elf.

13. D — His friends are coming
   kommen means to come.

14. D — neunzehn
   19 in German is neunzehn.

15. B — die Getränke
   das Wasser belongs to die Getränke.

16. C — to see
   We see with our eyes.

17. D — die Nase
   We smell with the nose.

18. C — der Sohn
   son in German is der Sohn.

19. B — habt
   ihr goes with habt.

20. D — das Sofa
   sofa in German is das Sofa.

21. C — Der Tisch ist in der Küche.
   Küche is a die word: in der Küche, with a capital K.

22. C — die Betten
   The plural of das Bett is die Betten.

23. A — April
   April means April.

24. B — der
   It is der Kuchen, so the little word is der.

25. C — die Karotte
   carrot in German is die Karotte.

26. A — der
   It is der Mais, so the little word is der.

27. C — der
   It is der Käse, so the little word is der.

28. A — der Kopf
   head in German is der Kopf.

29. B — der Schnee
   snow in German is der Schnee.

30. C — im
   Garten is a der word: in dem = im.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: The father is called Juma. He is tall. He is kind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each fact.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: Look at the title and pictures; read once for the gist; read again for details and answers.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Zucker, das Kind, das Sofa.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

34. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Party, der Fuß, der Kopf, die Tochter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

35. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Topf, das Gesicht, der Vater, die Oma.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

36. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: Ich habe im Mai Geburtstag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the pattern, 1 mark for a correctly spelled month.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: Line 1: one word; line 2: two words; line 3: three words; line 4: four words; line 5: one word.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for lines 1 and 2, 1 mark for lines 3 and 4, 1 mark for line 5 and the total of 11.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: Z (tset), A (ah), W (vay), A (ah), D (day), I (ee).
   Working / marking points: 3 marks if all letter names are correct; 2 marks for four or five; 1 mark for two or three.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Mutter, der Regenbogen, das Haar.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

40. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Arm, die Schwester.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Löffel, das Abendessen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

42. (5 marks)
   Answer: der Zeh, das Lied, der Saft, das Ei, das Wasser.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Tochter, die Orange.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: If you hear ee, write ie; if you hear eye, write ei.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

45. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Sonne, die Wolke, der Regen, der Schnee.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with its article.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Heute ist es sonnig. Es ist warm. Der Wind weht.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: auf; unter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
